commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'NGINX_INSTALLED='; if command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'yes\n'; else printf 'no\n'; fi
printf 'NGINX_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'NGINX_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled nginx 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'HTTP_STATUS='; curl -sS -o /tmp/nginx-baseline-body -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP/" || true
printf 'LISTENER='; ss -ltnp '( sport = :80 )' 2>/dev/null || true

000
